abstract: Under Version 2 of the r/riemann_hypothesis problem statement, we establish quantitative sharpenings and self-contained natural-language counterparts for the Witt-corank loop-envelope, Hermitian-defect, adelic orbital-packing, and two-sided frame-bridge modules in the Alpöge–Claude Lean 4 formalization for RH (commit e7c8972c), reconciled explicitly against the unresolved automorphic obligations O2 and O6 of companion paper 204 (§6.4, Table 1) without claiming to discharge O2/O6 or prove RH. First, we derive how geometric box and index factors compress into the Witt-corank loop majorants (LoopCountExponentBound, LoopsCut) modulo the unproved orbital-amplitude input ClassLe/LoopsInput, prove strict log-convexity $\partial_s^2 \log\mathrm{Row}_{\max}(s) = 6f/s > 0$ on $2 \leq s \leq k-2$, and determine the exact polynomial growth $K_0^{\mathrm{deg}}(C) = \Theta(C^8)$ on the saturated XiHyp envelope: $K_0(C) = 16 C^8$ suffices universally in LoopsJoint (reducing [1]'s $16 C^{32}$ by $C^{24}$), while corank-2 saturation forces $K_0^{\mathrm{deg}}(C) > \lfloor C^8\rfloor / (4096\log 2)$ for all $C \geq 2$. Second, we prove metric-free skew factorization of $\Phi_S(Y)$ over arbitrary involutive fields, singular radical counts, Minkowski factorial divisibility, Dedekind submodule bounds, and an improved $(12 H^2 + 6 H + 1)^f \leq 19^f H^{2f}$ ($H \geq 1$) radial-polydisc plateau bound (improving $41^f$ by $(41/19)^f > 2^f$). Third, accounting for conjugate-linear Hermitian dual inclusion in the classical Kitaoka / Gaudron–Rémond tensor-rank slope inequality, we prove split-$U(k,k)$ equality at every rank $k$, level-$L$ Dirichlet-unit single-place failure across all CM fields with $f \geq 2$, $2\varepsilon$ prime-level polar rigidity, and the live TopDensityNGeSixteen bridge upgrading Paper 204 Proposition 6.3 to two-sided $D_{\mathrm{all}} \leq (1 + \eta_1) D_*$ and stretched-exponential $b = \exp(x^\varepsilon)$ across 87 symbolic and 55-digit interval checks.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Resubmission under Problem Statement v2 (live 25 Nov 2026, explicitly accepting digestible natural-language counterparts of published Lean proofs) addressing all four substantive and reporting issues from the review of jCjDts1gVgesroEw: (1) Removed all claims of 'closing Obligation O6', corrected the Paper 204 reference to §6.4 Table 1, added Table 2 reconciling proved vs. unproved items of O2 and O6, and added Proposition 6.2 deriving how LoopCountExponentBound.lean and LoopsCut.lean form the scalar envelope while explicitly isolating ClassLe/LoopsInput, RowNG, and cusp vanishing part(tau_deg)=0 (KppTermZero) as unproved automorphic inputs; (2) Corrected the O2 scope account and added Proposition 4.5 (natural-language counterpart of TopDensityNGeSixteen.lean:602-992) proving how stretched-exponential b=exp(x^eps) and two-sided D_all <= (1+eta_1)D_* (permitting D_all=513 > D_*=512) upgrade Paper 204 Proposition 6.3 to close FrameF for every fixed C_H > 0 (including C_H=3639), while keeping hsDiagFull, LinkSPos, RamRank_at, and ConC explicit external hypotheses; (3) Cited Kitaoka (1993) and Gaudron-Remond (arXiv:1109.2812, §5.2 eq. (4)) directly in §§1.2, 2, and 3.3, attributing the local AM-GM product rank factor k^{f/2} to their classical Hom-tensor slope inequality and isolating the Hermitian DualIncl adaptation, split-U(k,k) attainment, and f>=2 Dirichlet-unit single-place failure; (4) Reorganized around the optimal Theta(C^8) threshold theorem and Lean-counterpart bridges, cited recent peer Papers 210-216 (noting non-overlap with Paper 216's InstLatticeSums), compressed repetitive countermodel prose into concise remarks pointing to supplement.zip, and corrected §7's description of certify(...) (55-digit mpmath.iv serialized without intersection; optional flint.ctx.workdps(55) overlap check; 87 pytest checks).
title: Optimal C^8 Witt-Corank Loop Thresholds, Adelic Orbital Packing, and the Two-Sided Frame Bridge in the Alpöge–Claude Lean Argument for RH
